reviews.text: Cannot rate this place highly enough! All of the team were fantastic and we felt as though our cat received great care. They took the time to get to know our cat alongside his likes and dislikes and in the end I think he was quite sad to leave! Will definitely be using again. Thank you 🙏

If I’m overly complimentary about Cat Vibes, it is well-deserved.  My daughter has moved to Amsterdam, with 2 cats and we desperately needed a place for them to stay while we waited for her apartment to be ready.  No hotels accepted cats so now I need to find a place for them!  I contacted Cat Vibes and at first there seemed to be no availability so I reached out to Lana directly and she offered help immediately!  Long story short, this place is amazing!  They only have yours and your precious kitties best interests at heart and will go beyond to take care of everything!   So happy we found you ❤️. Thank you, Lana!!

Due to the closure of the cat hotel where we had been going for 5 years, we suddenly had to look for a new place. We ended up at Cat Vibes and we are so happy with that!!😍 Super easy to reach, beautiful rooms, and a very warm welcome from Lana. Our cats stayed here for 3.5 weeks and we received nice daily updates, could watch along 24/7 via the camera, and got them back very relaxed❤️ Furthermore, one of the two cats wasn't eating very well in the evening. We didn't mind that so much, but Lana and Nikola took it very seriously. They did everything they could to resolve this, and they succeeded. We would 100% recommend Cat Vibes and will definitely be back! 😺

Our cat, Milton, stayed at Cat Vibes for over a week. It was his first experience at a cat hotel so I was very anxious, as he is a territorial cat who doesn’t like other cats. Additionally, he has some digestion issues and I was also afraid that the stress of a new environment would trigger the issue. However, we were more than happy with how everything went. 😊We booked him the suite advised on the website and the team took excellent care of Milton, sending us very detailed updates, which a lot of times made me laugh too. What I appreciated the most was how transparent Svetlana was, and of course all their patience and dedication devoted to Milton. They clearly tried everything to make him comfortable and happy, while respecting his strict cat boundaries. 😄 When we picked him up, he was clearly relaxed, happy and healthy, and doing much better than he did when he had pet sitters at home. I am very grateful for the service the hotel provided! The place is also very clean and they do an amazing job. We will definitely book it again and I highly recommend the hotel. I could travel in peace knowing that he was being looked after. Thank you for everything!

I could relax during my vacation knowing that my cat is in a good hands. Every room has a camera, so I could always see what my cat was doing, plus every day updates from the stuff with photos and videos. A huge bonus that I could bring my own cat food and leave the specific feeding instructions, to not interrupt the routine that my cat had. I will definitely choose this place the next time I need to leave 😺

The hotel was really spacious and cozy. I can see Ares is really happy staying there with so many friends an toys to play with. The staff was also very helpful when it comes to making Ares comfortable throughout her stays. They also give you 24 hours camera access and updates on how your cat doing everyday. Definitely will come again.

The best cat hotel in the country! 🥇
Cat rooms are clean and cozy, offering a lot of place to climb, hide and sleep in peace. Nikola and Lana are very attentive and true cat lovers, approaching every cat in an individual way, based on the cat’s character.
Our fluffy boy is a bit shy and very cuddly. He received cuddles and pet every day and was calm and relaxed.
We have experience with other cat hotels in the Netherlands where he was very stressed. Cat Vibes is on a completely different level, it’s cats’ happy place. 😻
Lana was sending us regular updates, pictures and videos, we had access to 24/7 monitoring of the room.
Big thanks to Lana and Nikola for taking care of our kitty, we will definitely bring him again. ❤️

It's a very lovely and cozy place that my cats adore! It's clean, with spacious rooms, vertical places, and everything that cats may need. My cats always have fun there with treats, playtime, lot's of cuddles from very dedicated people. They are in good hands!

I honestly couldn’t be happier with CatVibes and the care Boki received during his stay while i was on vacation.

Before finding CatVibes, I was very nervous about leaving Boki anywhere. He had never stayed anywhere except at home, and he is a very playful but also very shy cat. He loves having people around and playing, but at the same time he likes having his own space and can be quite sensitive to new environments. I spent a long time looking for the perfect place for him, and then I found CatVibes.

From the moment I visited, I immediately had a really good feeling about the place. Lana took the time to explain all the different room options and told me that Boki would also have the opportunity to leave his room and play with the other cats, depending on how comfortable he felt. What I really appreciated was that she didn’t just follow a fixed routine, she actually watched Boki, got to know his personality, and made decisions based on what she thought was best for him.

When Boki first arrived, he was understandably scared and, to my worry, he completely stopped eating. As a cat mom, this made me very nervous. But Lana was incredibly patient with him. Every day she encouraged him to try eating again, and she even fed him from her hand when necessary. Slowly but surely, Boki started feeling more comfortable and eventually began eating by himself again. 🥹❤️

Throughout his stay, I could really see how much the entire team cared about the cats. They don’t just provide a place for them to stay they genuinely spend time with them, play with them, pet them, keep them company, and make sure they feel safe and comfortable.

I received daily updates with photos, videos, and detailed messages about how Boki was doing and how he was progressing. It was so reassuring to see that each day he became more comfortable. Eventually, he even started coming out of his room by himself to play with the other cats! 🥹🐾

Another thing I really appreciated was having access to the camera in his room, so I could check on him whenever I wanted. Of course, at first it can be a little scary when you see your cat hiding or not eating, but honestly, don’t panic. The girls at CatVibes are so patient and caring and will do everything they can to help your cat feel comfortable. That is something I now know for sure!

They kept his room clean, made sure he always had fresh water, checked on him regularly, played with him, and gave him plenty of attention. Boki also has a specific diet, and that was absolutely no problem. I simply explained how his food needed to be prepared, and they followed it without any issues.

The people working at CatVibes are clearly true cat lovers. You can see that they genuinely enjoy what they do, and that makes such a huge difference. ❤️
I am incredibly grateful to Lana and everyone at CatVibes for taking such amazing care of my Boki and making his stay such a positive experience. I will 100% choose CatVibes again whenever I need someone to look after him.

And a little funny story to finish: when I came to pick Boki up, instead of running towards me, he actually ran away from me and straight towards the playroom! 😂😂 So I guess that tells you everything you need to know about how much he enjoyed his stay!

Thank you so much, Lana and the entire CatVibes team, for taking such good care of my baby and making sure he had the best time. 🥹I highly recommend CatVibes to any cat owner looking for a safe, caring and loving place for their cat. You will not regret it! ❤️🐱

Our two male cats, Bouda and Siam, stayed at Cat Vibes for a week and we are incredibly satisfied! They experienced their stay as very relaxed and stress-free. This was thanks in part to the fantastic service from the staff, with lots of cuddles, attention, and love for the cats. We could leave with peace of mind and would definitely choose Cat Vibes again. Highly recommended! 🐾❤️

We left our cat at the cat hotel for a week and are extremely satisfied. Communication with Lana was very pleasant, and we received a detailed update with photos every day. That really gave us peace of mind during our vacation.
You can tell that Lana has a lot of attention and love for the animals. Our wishes and feeding schedule were also taken into account very well. The suites are nicely and cozily furnished, and it was also nice that we could watch live if we missed our cat for a moment.
Our cat lacked nothing in terms of attention, and we would definitely leave her here again. Highly recommended!

Mia and Lily thoroughly enjoyed their three-week stay at this cat hotel. They were incredibly well cared for and clearly had a great time! 🐱❤️

I received a daily update with nice photos and information about how Mia and Lily spent their day. It is also nice that you can watch live in the room where your cats are staying.

I am extremely satisfied with the excellent care and personal attention. Definitely worth repeating! 🥰🐾

We had such a great first experience at Cat Vibes! 🐱🤎 Flo, our 5-month-old kitten, stayed for two weeks, and it was her first time being away from home, so we honestly didn’t know what to expect.

Thankfully, Flo integrated into the space really well and had a lovely time with Lana and her team. It’s such a relief to see that she’s eating well, playing happily, and getting lots of cuddles and attention. We also really appreciate being able to check on her anytime through the CCTV, it gives us so much peace of mind while we’re away.

The daily updates and reports are another lovely touch and really help us know how Flo is doing and feeling throughout her stay.

Overall, we’re very happy with the experience and would definitely recommend this place to all cat parents. We’ll absolutely be coming back for Flo’s future holidays!

Our cat spent 3 wonderful weeks here during our vacation. From the very beginning, it felt very familiar leaving him here. What I especially loved was that I received a daily update on how he was doing. It is so nice to know that he is enjoying himself, even over a longer period.

Additionally, the 24/7 live camera is a huge plus. You can check in on your cat's room at any moment, which gave me a lot of peace of mind and was secretly just really fun.

You can tell that the cats are cared for with great attention and love. After three weeks, I got a relaxed and contented cat back. I would absolutely recommend this cat hotel and would leave my cat here again without a doubt!

Thank you CatVibes for taking such good care of Zippir during her stay! It was her first stay at a cat hotel and she was a little nervous at first but they took such good care of her  so she was able to explore and open up at her own pace. I had access to a 24/7 live camera which was super nice! I also received updates every other day. The suites are spacious and thoughtfully designed! if your cat is a little shy (like mine) the solo rooms are perfect for them!! I'm from Utrecht and I'm glad I booked this place and would do it again!! I knew she was in good hands & Zippir definitely enjoyed her room,  I usually don't write reviews but this place really deserved it thank u soo much again ! :))!!

Highly recommended!! For the first time in 6 years, we took our house cat to a cat hotel during our vacation. All our worries were immediately allayed. We received a daily update with photos and a video, and also had 24/7 access to the webcam. Top-notch care!

The staff at Cat Vibes did an excellent job of caring for my cat during our vacation. It was a treat to receive their updates with photos, so I could see how well she was doing. We will use them again from our next vacation!

I had my 4-year-old cat stay in a hotel for the first time while I went on vacation for 10 days, and I can only agree with everything the other reviews have said:

- The daily updates at the end of the day provide a personal report on how your cat is doing, from behavior to eating habits
- The live camera (which can also rotate) gives you peace of mind
- The rooms/cabins are spacious, made of premium materials, and look clean
- Communication during the stay (via WhatsApp) went well

I don't know how Lana and her team manage to run such a beautiful cat hotel, but my own experience and that of others makes it clear: they are doing a good job, and I will definitely be back!

We are very satisfied with the cat hotel: Cat Vibes! The owner is very friendly and professional. Every day I received a detailed report on the cats with various photos and sometimes videos. I was also able to watch along daily via the camera to see how they were doing.
All in all, we had a very good experience at this company, and a stay for the cats is definitely worth repeating and has already been booked!!

We had a great experience. The place was very clean and every day we received photos, videos, and updates about our cat. A big plus was the cctv, so we could check on our cat and feel calm. The staff were very friendly and caring. Highly recommended!

100% recommended - super helpful service. They really care about the individual cats; their behavior, diet, medication use, etc. You also get 24/7 live webcam access to watch the room, and if you want, daily WhatsApp updates on how things went, including photos and videos. Judging by our cat's appearance, he seemed to have had a great time there. Top-notch service.
Thank you very much again

The place is amazing and the owners are great! We’ve had bad experiences with other kattenpensions (rude staff, mix with dogs, dirty and unhygienic etc) and the experience with Cat Vibes was the complete opposite. Really happy to have found this place and left my cat in their care. They gave a lot of attention to the cats which my cat loves and seem to genuinely love each and every one of them. I get detailed updates every day as well as access to the in room camera whenever I miss him so it really eases the anxiety I feel being away and was able to properly enjoy my holiday. The place was very clean and I can’t thank them enough for this. Will definitely be using them again each time we need help with our cats!

I can't recommend Cat Vibed enough!!! We left our senior cat there for 10 days and he had the best time! We received daily updates (food intake, toilet and behavior) and we could see him 24/7 through the webcam. It was such a relief knowing that he was well taken care of! The room was nice and cozy and extremely clean. Great experience overall!

Really loving and caring staff. They updated me every day for 9 days during my holiday. Could also have logged in to the.account and camera's but every day I got a report with foto's and videos with and description of how the day went and how they played with my cat and what toys he really liked.

Wow! I was kept updated every day via updates and photos and could watch my sweet cat 24/7 via an app on my phone. The communication with Lana was really good and clear. Lana is sweet and reliable; she really listened well to my cat. Thank you! ❤️❤️🙏🏻🙏🏻 …

Cucu had an amazing time there. Everything was perfect and the staffs were extremely helpful and friendly. I was truly afraid that my cat would actually preferring staying in the hotel instead coming home with me.

Carmen (a Ragdoll) stayed at Cat Vibes Kattenhotel in June 2026. The hotel is close to Schiphol, newly built, and the cat enclosures are luxurious. Importantly Lana showed a genuine interest in, and care for, Carmen, sending us daily pictures and a report on her well being and answering questions. There is also CCTV in each cat enclosure so you can look in at any time day or night and see how your cat is doing. Highly recommended - we have already booked another 2 visits in advance of our holidays.

It was really pleasure to be here! Our cats had a lovely and relaxing time for a week. The staffs were nice, took a real nice care, and shared videos and photos with detailed notes. Everything was very satisfying 🤍 …

This cat hotel is amazing! We were a little nervous about bringing our cat away for the first time, but it all went very well. It was very important to us that we found a hotel where our cat had her own room.

The staff did a great job taking care of our cat. We loved the daily updates with pictures and videos, and it was great to be able to watch her through the live camera whenever we wanted. We will definitely come back here if we need a cat hotel again!

Our cats were wonderfully taken care of by Lana and the team. They gave us great daily updates in which we could see how happy and content our two fluffy kids were. We’ll 100% be back whenever we need someone to take care of them

CatVibes in Amsterdam is the perfect solution for boarding your cat when she is on vacation and cannot find a sitter. It is a perfect place with sweet, dedicated staff who keep you updated every day on how things are going with videos and a thorough report via WhatsApp. The hotel rooms are spacious (various sizes available) and everything is clean and safe. You can also view your cat all day long (if you wish) via a camera. So you can check in remotely every now and then with your phone, and at the end of the day, you receive a good report with photos and videos. We highly recommend CatVibes, and the next time we go on vacation and can't find a sitter, our sweet cat will simply go back to CatVibes!

We are incredibly satisfied with our cats' stay at this cat hotel. For the first time, we went on a completely stress-free vacation because we knew our cats were in very good hands. That feeling of trust and peace of mind is truly priceless.

From the very first moment, you notice how much love and attention the cats receive. Our cats were not only well looked after but also truly cared for with love. Their needs, their need for rest, and their individual personalities were taken into account. This gave us enormous confidence during our vacation.

The environment in which the cats stayed was quiet, clean, and relaxed, allowing them to visibly feel at ease. It was very nice to know that they were not only being cared for but also receiving genuine attention and love from people who clearly have a big heart for animals.

We also found the camera surveillance to be a huge plus. It provided an extra sense of safety and care, allowing us to enjoy our vacation with peace of mind and without worrying.

You can tell from everything that this cat hotel is run with passion and love. The communication was pleasant, the care excellent, and the atmosphere warm and familiar. We would undoubtedly place our cats here again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for safe, loving, and stress-free care for their cats.

Our little 7 months British shorthair kitten stayed in Cat Vibes hotel and we could not be more satisfied by the services. Daily updates for his day and flexibility to accommodate his feeding needs. We went oin a vacation for almost a month and him staying safe and happy during that period was a priority for us. They use high quality of food and litter as well as multiple legit brand air purifiers around the hotel to keep the air clean. Shout-out to Lana for taking care of him and loving his as we do. Totally recommend this cat hotel for your cat.

We had an amazing experience with Lana at Cat Vibes. When we dropped off our cat, Butter Chicken, the hotel was incredibly clean and organized. We loved that he was able to keep his own food and toys to feel more at home. During the first two weeks, Lana sent us daily updates, and we could see he was having a lot of fun!
Unfortunately, after two weeks, he started feeling unwell. Lana was absolutely incredible during this stressful time. She was always available, kept us fully informed, and promptly took him to the vet for check-ups. Since he wasn't improving, we decided to cut our trip short and come back early. Even after we took him home, Lana constantly checked in to see how he was recovering. Her true dedication, love for cats, and sense of responsibility are exceptional. We highly recommend Cat Vibes and will definitely trust Lana with Butter Chicken again for our future long trips!

Super satisfied after the 2 weeks of pet sitting during my vacation. Nice daily updates via WhatsApp, and you can see that your pet is cared for with love and pleasure. They also pay close attention to your pet's wishes, such as whether or not to be with other cats, etc. Definitely recommended if you want to go on vacation with peace of mind 😃

We went to Japan for almost 3 weeks and needed a place for our two cats to stay. This place was recommended by a colleague so we gave it a try.

It took a few days for our cats to settle in. In those days they were given space but also closely monitored by the staff on their food intake and health. Once they were settled they became super relaxed, happy,  and curious, exploring their surroundings and getting cuddles and playtime from staff. I was no longer worried about how my cats were doing, as they were in good hands.

The staff is very knowledgeable on cats, their behavior and their nutrition. I loved the WhatsApp updates and being able to view them on the camera whenever I was curious.

When I picked up the cats, I noticed they seem more confident at home from their experiences at the hotel.
Definitely recommend this hotel to everyone!!
My cat had a great time in the cat hotel! He is a shy boy but he made new cat friends there!

Lana provides a top-tier service that I cannot recommend highly enough. The 24-hour camera access and daily updates provided much-needed peace of mind while we were traveling. Seeing our lovely cat so well-cared-for in the updates made our holiday much more enjoyable.
Professional, reliable, and clearly a true animal lover. 10/10.

My cat had a great time staying at catvibes. Lana is very attentive and knowledgeable about cats and how to take care of them. I received detailed daily updates on how my cat was settling in, which I really appreciated. I definitely recommend this place 😊 …

Knowing my cat is in great hands, gives me the relaxed feeling I need when I’m on holiday. It’s so nice to be able to watch him on the camera in his room and the daily updates of his adventures give me the impression that he too is enjoying his holiday.

The owner of the hotel is so good and especially so patient with the cats. It honestly warms my heart to see ♥️  Nielsje clearly loves her!

I’m recommending this hotel to every cat-owner I know!

Our cat had the time of her life during her 3-week stay! And we had a wonderful, carefree holiday thanks to the updates with photos and videos and the 24/7 camera – truly perfect ☺️ We would definitely bring our cat again because it is clear she clicked really well with Lana. Highly recommended 👍🏼 …
Thanks, Lana, for taking good  care of our cat Riley while we were away. He felt right at home. I highly recommend Cat Vibes!

We’re incredibly grateful to Lana for her outstanding care and service. It was our first time leaving our cat, and we truly couldn’t have made a better decision than choosing CatVibes.

Lana is a true professional who clearly knows exactly what she’s doing. She was patient, understanding, and very attentive to all of my messages, responding quickly and thoughtfully since the beginning.

The daily updates that we received also gave us real peace of mind while we were away.

Our cat settled in by the second day and even made a little friend, which I’m sure he’ll miss! It meant a lot to know he was not only safe, but also comfortable and cared for in such a warm environment.

We wholeheartedly recommend Lana and CatVibes - it’s hands down one of the best and safest places you can leave your cat while you’re away.

Our cats are very important to us. When we are away, we want them to be well taken care of. We therefore searched for a long time for a good and suitable place for them to stay. Catvibes offers that for us. You can tell that these people are animal lovers. The advantage is that you can check on your cats whenever you want via a camera. And then you also see that our cats Malbec and Merlot are very much at ease. After a day of settling in, you can see that they get excited when someone comes into their suite to play with them. We also find the updates via WhatsApp incredibly pleasant. It gives us peace of mind during our holiday. It was very nice to see that our cats really built a good bond with Lana in a very short time. Another advantage is that Catvibes is close to Schiphol, so we can drop off or pick up Malbec and Merlot immediately when we leave for or return from our holiday. We are very happy with Lana and Tessa and their care for our cats.

We are so happy that we finally found such a wonderful cat hotel for our cat. It was very reassuring to be able to check on him through the camera. Big compliments to Svetlana for everything she has created and for her true passion for cats. We received daily updates with photos and videos, which gave us a great sense of peace and comfort while we were on vacation.

Our Mia has been a little too sensitive after her spaying surgery, so we were quite nervous to leave her at a cat hotel for the first time. She struggled a bit the first day and a half but then started to get more curious, eat and use her litter box again. I am so incredibly happy we have choosen this place, because, without a private room only for her, she would have seriously struggled. The setup is great for all sorts of cat personalities, and the live camera and daily updates from the team really helped us managing the stress of the first two days. Lana was very patient, caring and extremely professional, and kept going above and beyond to reassure Mia as well as her super apprehensive cat-parents. See you again soon! 🐾

I cannot recommend Cat Vibes enough! My cat Yin stayed here for three weeks and had a wonderful time. She can be quite shy in new environments, so I was initially a bit anxious, but it was amazing to see how quickly she relaxed and came out of her shell thanks to Lana’s care and patience.

It was very reassuring to receive daily updates (that were so nice and elaborate!) and see how comfortable and curious she became. By the end, she was confidently exploring and even showing interest in the other cats - something she had never done before!

You can really tell the cats are cared for with so much attention and love here. I felt completely at ease leaving Yin at Cat Vibes, and we will definitely be coming back!! 🫶🏻

Very nice hotel for cats.

Our cat received a lot of attention and was well cared for with daily updates. Definitely recommended!

We had such a wonderful experience at Cat Vibes for our cat Pip! The personal, loving attention and care from Lana really made the difference! Thanks to the daily updates and 24/7 access to the camera, we knew Pip was doing well, which allowed us to enjoy our vacation.

Pip is quite an anxious cat around others, but thanks to the calm and sweet approach, there was an immediate connection, and we saw a relaxed, loudly purring Pip giving headbutts.

Furthermore, Pip was closely monitored regarding her eating, drinking, and excretions.
With some adjustments made after consultation with us, this was also resolved thanks to the good observation.
Thank you so much again!

We are incredibly happy with you; Pip will definitely be back with you in her private suite!

I am extremely satisfied with this cat hotel. From the very first contact with Lana, it felt right immediately. She is always available, responds quickly to messages, and really takes the time to calmly answer all your questions.
During my cat's stay, I received a daily update, which gave me a lot of peace of mind. I also really appreciated the presence of cameras, ensuring there is always good supervision. That provides extra confidence.

Lana is very sweet, patient, and caring with the cats. All my wishes were respected, and I noticed that my cat was truly in good hands.

Thank you, Lana, for the wonderful care. I can absolutely recommend this cat hotel to anyone looking for a safe and loving place for their cat.

This was our first time cat hotel experience and I am sure it would be so hard to find a better experience than Cat Vibes. Our cats had a comfy stay with daily care and fun while we were informed daily and felt secure. Also, they were able very flexible when we needed to extend the stay for 2 days.

My cat had an amazing time with the hotel and the daily updates were very funny and nice to see! The camera was also very reassuring to have because i was able to check up on my cat whenever i wanted to.
Cat vibes is really an amazing place to leave your kat if you cannot take your little pet with you, they take care of them with alot of love. I really recommend this place.

Nice place. My cat had a good stay there. Well prepared for cats. Clean and kind team.
Thank you
The facility is spotless, the staff is genuinely caring, and the daily photo updates kept my mind at ease. My cats came home happy and relaxed. I won't go anywhere else!
Lana took incredibly good care of our cat. It was her first time, and she took all the time she needed to get used to her new surroundings and explore. She came home very relaxed. We're very happy.

Lana took wonderful care of our cat while we were on holiday. It was our first time leaving him, so we were quite nervous. However, her daily updates and access to the 24-hour camera in his room gave us so much reassurance. We could clearly see that he was in great hands and having a lovely time. We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend her and would happily use her services again.

We are beyond grateful for the incredible care our cat received at Cat Vibes Kattenhotel.  Our cat stayed there for 30 days last summer vacation, and honestly, we could not have chosen a better place.

From the very first contact, the communication was outstanding. Clear, fast, and genuinely kind. You immediately feel that they understand how emotional it can be to leave your cat for a longer period. They answered every question patiently and made us feel completely at ease.

One of the things we appreciated most was the live camera access. Being able to check in and see our sweet cat relaxing, playing, or exploring gave us so much peace of mind. It truly made the distance easier, knowing we could see that our cat was happy and comfortable.

The level of care was exceptional. You can tell this is not just a boarding facility, it’s a place where cats are genuinely loved and cared for. The play areas are spacious and thoughtfully designed, giving cats room to move, explore, and feel stimulated in a safe environment. Everything is clean, calm, and beautifully maintained.

When we picked our cat up after 30 days, they were relaxed, healthy, and completely themselves, no stress, no anxiety. That says everything.

If you are looking for a warm, professional, and truly loving place for your cat in Amsterdam, this is it. They don’t just take care of cats here,  they treat them like family

I had my two cats cared for by Cat Vibes for a month and a half with complete peace of mind, and I'm extremely satisfied.

The care was truly excellent: they paid close attention to their well-being and needs, making them feel at ease. I also received a daily update, which was very helpful during my absence.

I also really appreciated that, in the event of an incident, they contacted me immediately and clearly discussed the next steps. That gave me a lot of confidence.

In short: reliable, dedicated, and professional care. Highly recommended!

Of course, I have a neighbor or friend who can feed my cat every day, scoop the litter box, and so on.
However, I chose Catvibes because I know my cat appreciates more personal attention, cuddles, and playtime.
Catvibes met all my expectations.
I received daily updates on how she was doing and adjusting.
Lana is exceptionally knowledgeable and has a passion for cats.
Knowing my cat was in good hands allowed me to relax and enjoy a long weekend away.
I will definitely entrust her to the professionals at Catvibes again for my next trip.

I can’t recommend Cat Vibes Kattenhotel enough !

This was the first time I had ever put Pisco in a cat hotel, so naturally I was a bit nervous. From the very beginning, Lana and her team went above and beyond to reassure me. I was able to visit beforehand and meet Lana in person, which I truly appreciated and it immediately gave me peace of mind.

It’s clear that they are true animal lovers. They took such thoughtful care of Pisco, making sure she felt comfortable and even ensuring she had her favorite food. I received daily, adorable updates that meant so much to me and provided so much reassurance while I was away.

What really stands out is that Lana and her team don’t just care for our furry babies. They care about us humans too. Their warmth, communication, and genuine dedication make all the difference.

I wouldn’t hesitate for a second to bring Pisco back. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of her Lana and team !

I used Cat Vibes for my two cats during a complicated international move, and I honestly could not have asked for a better experience. The way they cater to cats goes beyond “boarding” — it’s tailored, thoughtful, and clearly designed by people who genuinely understand feline behaviour.

The different room options are great depending on personality and comfort level, and the space itself is clean, accessible, and well-organised.

But the real magic here is Lana. She is an incredible host with a heart of gold. My situation involved delays, logistics, and uncertainty, and throughout all of it she remained flexible, communicative, and solution-oriented. Instead of treating me like just another customer, she made me feel like a partner working through things together — and that kind of care is rare.

My cats were safe, calm, and well looked after, and I had peace of mind during a very stressful period. If you’re a cat parent who values quality and compassion, I highly recommend Cat Vibes.
